test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight friends are sitting around a square table, four at the corners and four in the middle of the four sides. All of them are facing the centre. Cindy is an immediate neighbour of both Leo and Roger. Both Leo and Roger are sitting at the corners. Only three people sit between Kate and Dylan. Ben is second to the right of Leo. Cindy is second to the right of Dylan. Only three people sit between Louis and Cindy. Myra is second to the left of Roger. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Dylan?
solution:
Eight friends are sitting around a square table, four at the corners and four in the middle of the four sides. 

All of them are facing the centre. 

1. Cindy is an immediate neighbour of both Leo and Roger. 

2. Both Leo and Roger are sitting at the corners. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/313ab909b3693d7ebdc0111af427ce640418339b1eebd4526fb74ca8bcc1bc7b.png] 

3. Ben is second to the right of Leo. 

The above condition cannot be satisfied in Case II, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/313ab909b3693d7ebdc0111af427ce640418339b1eebd4526fb74ca8bcc1bc7b.png] 

4. Cindy is second to the right of Dylan. 

5. Only three people sit between Kate and Dylan. 

6. Only three people sit between Louis and Cindy. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/507834bce923bf0160b952e92ae60f891d92f9e306309eec46e1f200bdfa3e93.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ce15e90e12d493bdb5c36f7df421c477594b6bfaed969964bcd1386fe232e08.png] 

7. Myra is second to the left of Roger. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52f6dcd3f11ad1dd98dea26d156f3ee02b433b28ff67c4c278cc09aa18126b60.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db4de4ae75bb21ab714a34df13f758397ed289d287e11af97d7ac15020566e4a.png] 

Clearly, Roger is sitting to the immediate right of Dylan.

Hence, '**Roger**' is the correct answer.
